---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a capability or improvement for BlackLetter
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Summary

A clear one- or two-sentence description of the feature and the problem it solves.

## Use case

Describe the scenario in which you would use this capability, and who benefits from it. For example: "When I finish a research session, I want to..."

## Proposed behavior

What should the product do?

## Design considerations

Anything that should be constrained by the design system (see `docs/Design-System.md`): placement in the UI, naming per the system vocabulary, interaction style.

## Alternatives

What workaround or alternative behavior exists today, and why is it inadequate?

## Additional context

Links to related issues, sketches, or references from other products that illustrate the idea.
